crossRefs.note: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.
His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were…
The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:

translations.web: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.
translations.bsb: “Here comes that dreamer!” they said to one another.
translations.kjv: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
translations.asv: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
